questions.question_text: According to Section 1, what is the primary reason for choosing a specific high school issue to solve for your capstone project?

options.text: To impress teachers with a complex problem
To ensure the project is meaningful and relevant, increasing its potential impact
To focus only on issues that affect the entire school population
To avoid using technology for smaller challengesCorrect Answer: B) To ensure the project is meaningful and relevant, increasing its potential impact

questions.question_text: Based on Section 2, what is a key purpose of using digital or AI tools to create a solution for a high school challenge?

options.text: To demonstrate advanced coding skills even if unnecessary
To provide efficiency, scalability, and personalization in addressing the issue
To replace all traditional methods without considering their benefits
To focus solely on expensive tools for professional resultsCorrect Answer: B) To provide efficiency, scalability, and personalization in addressing the issue

questions.question_text: What is an important consideration when thinking about the ethical use of a tech tool, as discussed in Section 3?

options.text: Ignoring potential risks to focus only on benefits
Identifying both right and wrong ways to use the tool to avoid harm or misuse
Ensuring the tool is used only by tech experts
Avoiding any discussion of privacy concerns to simplify the projectCorrect Answer: B) Identifying both right and wrong ways to use the tool to avoid harm or misuse

questions.question_text: In Section 4, what is a recommended strategy for preparing an effective presentation of your tech solution to classmates?

options.text: Including as much technical jargon as possible to sound knowledgeable
Structuring the talk into concise parts like introduction, solution overview, ethical use, and conclusion
Avoiding visuals to focus entirely on spoken explanations
Speaking as quickly as possible to cover all details in under a minuteCorrect Answer: B) Structuring the talk into concise parts like introduction, solution overview, ethical use, and conclusion

questions.question_text: According to Section 5, why is it important to set goals for improving tech skills before graduation?

options.text: To guarantee immediate job offers after high school
To stay adaptable and prepared for college, careers, and a tech-driven world
To focus only on skills unrelated to the capstone project
To avoid learning new tools after high school endsCorrect Answer: B) To stay adaptable and prepared for college, careers, and a tech-driven world

questions.question_text: What is a suggested approach in Section 2 for creating a tech solution if you lack advanced coding skills?

options.text: Abandoning the project due to lack of expertise
Focusing on a conceptual mockup or detailed plan using accessible tools like Canva or Google Docs
Hiring a professional to build the solution for you
Using only paid software to ensure quality resultsCorrect Answer: B) Focusing on a conceptual mockup or detailed plan using accessible tools like Canva or Google Docs

questions.question_text: As highlighted in Section 3, what is a potential “wrong way” to use a study schedule app that could undermine its purpose?

options.text: Setting realistic daily goals to stay on track
Overloading it with unrealistic tasks, causing more stress than organization
Checking it briefly each morning for updates
Using color-coding to differentiate subjectsCorrect Answer: B) Overloading it with unrealistic tasks, causing more stress than organization

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of sharing your tech solution idea with classmates, as discussed in Section 4?

options.text: It guarantees everyone will adopt your solution immediately
It allows you to gain feedback, learn from peers, and build confidence in public speaking
It eliminates the need to refine your project further
It focuses only on competing with other students’ ideasCorrect Answer: B) It allows you to gain feedback, learn from peers, and build confidence in public speaking
